units.source_text: 有一个闲静的黄昏，源氏公子召唤右近到身边，和她谈话。

en.t: One quiet evening, Prince Genji summoned Ukon to his side and spoke with her.

units.source_text: 他说：“我到现在还觉得奇怪：为什么她隐瞒自己的身份呢？

en.t: He said, “Even now I still find it strange: why did she hide who she was?

units.source_text: 即使真像她自己所说，是个无家可归的流浪儿，但我如此倾慕她，她不体谅我的真心，始终和我隔膜，真教我伤心啊！”

en.t: Even if she truly was, as she said, a homeless wanderer, I adored her so deeply; yet she would not understand my sincerity and kept a distance from me to the end, which grieves me terribly!”

units.source_text: 右近答道：“她何尝想隐瞒到底？

en.t: Ukon answered, “She never meant to hide it forever.

units.source_text: 她以为以后总有机会将真姓名奉告。

en.t: She thought there would surely be a chance later to tell you her true name.

units.source_text: 只因你俩最初相逢，便是意想不到的奇怪姻缘，她以为是做梦。

en.t: Because your first meeting was such an unexpected and mysterious bond, she felt as if she were dreaming.

units.source_text: 她推察：您所以隐名，是为了身份高贵，名誉攸关之故；

en.t: She guessed that you concealed your name because your rank was high and your reputation was at stake;

units.source_text: 您并非真心爱她，只是逢场作戏而已。

en.t: that you did not truly love her, but were only amusing yourself for the moment.

units.source_text: 她很伤心，所以也对您隐瞒。”

en.t: She was deeply hurt, and so she hid herself from you as well.”

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“互相隐瞒，真是无聊。

en.t: Prince Genji said, “For us to hide things from each other was truly foolish.

units.source_text: 但我的隐瞒，并非出于本心。

en.t: But my concealment did not come from my true feelings.

units.source_text: 只因此种世人所不许的偷情行为，我一向不曾做过。

en.t: It was only because I had never before done such a secret affair, one the world would not permit.

units.source_text: 首先是父皇有过训诫；此外对各方面有种种顾忌。

en.t: First of all, my imperial father had warned me, and besides that I had many concerns on every side.

units.source_text: 偶尔略有戏言，即被夸张传扬，肆意批评，因此我平日小心翼翼，不敢胡言妄为。

en.t: If I so much as made a playful remark, it would be exaggerated, spread about, and criticized at will, so I have always been cautious and dared not speak or act rashly.

units.source_text: 岂知那天傍晚，只为一朵夕颜花的姻缘，对那人一见倾心，结了不解之缘，现在想来，这正是恩爱不能久长之兆，多么可悲！

en.t: Who could have known that evening, through the bond of a single evening face flower, I would fall in love with her at first sight and form an inescapable tie; now I think it was a sign that our love could not last long, and how sorrowful that is!

units.source_text: 反过来想，又觉得多么可恨：既然姻缘短促，何必如此倾心相爱？

en.t: Thinking of it another way, it feels bitterly cruel: if our bond was so brief, why did we have to love each other so wholeheartedly?

units.source_text: 现在已毫无隐瞒之必要，愿你详细告诉我吧。

en.t: Now there is no need to hide anything, so please tell me everything in detail.

units.source_text: 七七之内，要教人描绘佛像送寺中供养，为死者祝福。

en.t: Within the forty-nine days, I must have someone paint a Buddhist image and present it to a temple as an offering, praying for the dead.

units.source_text: 若不知姓名，则念佛诵经之时，心中对谁回向[\[33\]](#part1333.html#m33)呢？”

en.t: If I do not know her name, then when I chant the Buddha’s name and recite sutras, to whom should I dedicate the merit in my heart?”

units.source_text: 右近说：“我何必隐瞒？

en.t: Ukon said, “Why should I hide it?

units.source_text: 只因小姐自己已经隐瞒到底，我在她死后将实情说出，深恐有些冒失而已。

en.t: It is only that my lady herself hid it to the end, and I feared it might be improper to reveal the truth after her death.

units.source_text: 小姐早岁父母双亡。

en.t: My lady lost both her parents when she was young.

units.source_text: 父亲身居三位中将之职，对女儿十分疼爱；只因身份低微，无力提拔女儿，教她发迹，故而郁悒不欢，终于身亡。

en.t: Her father held the office of Third-Rank Middle Captain and loved his daughter dearly, but because his standing was low he could not raise her prospects or help her rise in the world; he became depressed and unhappy, and finally died.

units.source_text: 其后小姐由于偶然机会，认识了那位头中将，那时他还是少将。

en.t: After that, by chance, my lady came to know that Captain, who at the time was still a Lesser Captain.

units.source_text: 两人一见倾心，情深如海，三年以来，恩爱不绝。

en.t: The two fell in love at first sight, their feelings were as deep as the sea, and for three years their affection never ceased.

units.source_text: 直至去年秋天，右大臣家[\[34\]](#part1333.html#m34)派人前来问罪，百般恐吓。

en.t: Then last autumn, the Minister of the Right’s household sent people to confront her and threaten her in every way.

units.source_text: 我家小姐生性胆怯，受此打击，不胜恐怖，便逃往西京她的乳母家躲藏了。

en.t: My lady was timid by nature, and after such a blow she was overcome with fear, so she fled to her nurse’s house in western Kyoto and hid there.

units.source_text: 然而那里生涯艰苦，实难久居。

en.t: But life there was hard, and it was truly difficult to stay for long.

units.source_text: 她想迁居山中，可是今年这方向不吉。

en.t: She wanted to move into the mountains, but this year that direction was unlucky.

units.source_text: 为了避凶，就在五条的那所简陋小屋里暂住，不料在那里又被公子发现，小姐曾为此而叹息。

en.t: To avoid misfortune, she temporarily stayed in that humble little house on Fifth Avenue, but unexpectedly you found her there too, and my lady sighed over it.

units.source_text: 小姐性情与一般人不同，非常小心谨慎，善于隐忍，即使忧思满腹，也不形之于色，认为被人见了是羞耻的。

en.t: My lady’s nature was unlike other people’s: she was extremely careful and restrained, good at enduring silently, and even when her heart was full of sorrow she did not show it on her face, believing it shameful for others to see.

units.source_text: 在您面前，她也装作若无其事。”

en.t: Before you as well, she pretended that nothing was the matter.”

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“不出所料，果然就是头中将所讲的那个常夏。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, “Just as I expected, she was indeed that Tokonatsu the Captain spoke of.”

units.source_text: 他越发可怜她了。

en.t: He pitied her all the more.

units.source_text: 便问：“头中将曾经忧叹，说那小孩不知去向了。

en.t: Then he asked, “The Captain once grieved that the child’s whereabouts were unknown.

units.source_text: 是否有个小孩？”

en.t: Was there a child?”

units.source_text: 右近答道：“有的。

en.t: Ukon answered, “There was.

units.source_text: 是前年春天生的，是个女孩，非常可爱。”

en.t: She was born in the spring two years ago, a girl, and very lovely.”

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“那么这孩子现在在哪里呢？

en.t: Prince Genji said, “Then where is the child now?

units.source_text: 你不要让别人知道，悄悄地把她领来交给我吧。

en.t: Do not let anyone else know; quietly bring her here and entrust her to me.

units.source_text: 那人死得影迹全无，甚是可怜。

en.t: That woman died leaving no trace behind, and it is deeply pitiful.

units.source_text: 如今有了这个遗孤，我心甚喜。”

en.t: Now that there is this orphan she left behind, my heart is very glad.”

units.source_text: 既而又说：“我想将此事告知头中将，但是受他抱怨反而无趣，且不告诉他吧。

en.t: After a while he added, “I would like to tell the Captain about this, but if he resents me it would only be unpleasant, so for now I will not tell him.

units.source_text: 总之，这孩子由我养育，并无不当之处[\[35\]](#part1333.html#m35)。

en.t: In any case, there is nothing improper about my raising this child.

units.source_text: 你想些借口，搪塞了她的乳母，叫她一同来此吧。”

en.t: Think of some excuse, put off her nurse with it, and have her come here together with the child.”

units.source_text: 右近说：“能够如此，感恩不尽。

en.t: Ukon said, “If you would do that, I would be endlessly grateful.

units.source_text: 教她在西京成长，真是难为了她。

en.t: It has truly been hard on her to be raised in western Kyoto.

units.source_text: 只因此外别无可托之人，权且寄养在那里。”

en.t: Only because there was no one else to entrust her to, we had no choice but to leave her there for the time being.”
